audit.why: 49.83% over 905 games. FAVOURED at 4/10 is generous against a sub-50% win rate, but the lane pattern behind it holds — Anivia has no dash and Frostbite only reaches 650 — so the rating is left and the reasons are made honest instead.

Both layers already read Akshan on all seven rows and match packet.levelChart, so there is no chart disagreement to repair here. The row reasoning was wrong in places (see point 4) and those whys are rewritten in place.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page had the range relationship backwards and the terrain interaction inverted. whys[3] claimed 'he keeps the range advantage' — Flash Frost is 1075 range against your 850 Avengerang, so she outranges you. whys[4] and the content mid block claimed Heroic Swing 'can go around/over her wall placements'; Riot's own E text says he 'gets knocked off when colliding with champions or terrain', and Crystallize is exactly that — an impassable wall. Frostbite's doubling condition (recently hit by Flash Frost, or damaged by a fully formed Glacial Storm) was never stated, and neither was Rebirth's effect on Comeuppance, which scales on missing health and therefore finds a freshly reborn full-health egg.
audit.why: Riot text, enemy W: 'impassable wall of ice to block all movement'. Enemy E: damage doubled if the target 'was recently hit by Flash Frost or damaged by a fully formed Glacial Storm'. Enemy P: 'reverts to an egg and is reborn with full health'. Owner E and R text as quoted.
